name: After § 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text: 6a. Welcomes the release of 52 people, including 40 political prisoners, on 11 September 2025 as part of a deal between Belarusian President Aliaksandr Lukashenka and US President Donald Trump; notes the growing gap between pragmatic US engagement, easing sanctions in exchange for the release of prisoners, and the EU’s strict human rights approach; calls for the EU to consider limited diplomatic opening and dialogue in order to discuss the release of political prisoners and the end of Belarus’s hybrid warfare against EU Member States;
